facts.value: Application deadlines, forms, and application addresses can be found on the central website of the University of Frankfurt.
All information regarding specific application and admission conditions can be found on the website of the student secretariat.
Applications for the first semester require prior registration via hochschulstart.de.
An application is only possible if you have received your BID & BAN through hochschulstart.de.
Further information about the dialogue-oriented service procedure can be found here: hochschulstart.de.
An information sheet on the application process for the 1st semester can be found here: http://www.uni-frankfurt.de/78215749/Schaubild_Bewerbungsablauf_1Fachsemester.pdf.
Complete and sign the recognition of examination achievements form and submit it with your application documents to the student secretariat.
Subsequent recognition of achievements is excluded.
